subject: social
title: Reading a town map
topic: Directions on a map: north, south, east, west
instruction: Tap the places on the map of Sunpur. Then find places using directions.
intro: This is a map of a small town. North is at the top. Tap the places to explore.
exploreText: North is at the top of the map. Look at the compass.

regions.label: School
regions.text: The school is in the north-west corner of the town.

regions.label: Fields
regions.text: Farmers grow rice and vegetables in the fields, in the north of the town.

regions.label: Lake
regions.text: The lake is in the west. Ducks swim here, and it gives water to the fields.

regions.label: Park
regions.text: The park is in the middle of the town. Roads go out from it in every direction.

regions.label: Market
regions.text: The market is in the east. People buy fruit, vegetables and cloth here.

regions.label: Railway station
regions.text: Trains stop at the station, in the south-west corner.

regions.label: Hospital
regions.text: The hospital is in the south, straight below the park.

regions.label: Post office
regions.text: Letters and parcels are sent from the post office, in the south-east corner.

find.text: Tap the place that is north of the park.
find.say: The fields are north of the park.

find.text: Tap the place that is east of the park.
find.say: The market is east of the park.

find.text: Tap the place that is west of the park.
find.say: The lake is west of the park.

find.text: You are at the hospital. Walk north. Which place do you reach first?
find.say: Walking north from the hospital, you reach the park.

find.text: Tap the place in the south-east corner of the town.
find.say: The post office is in the south-east.

find.text: The school is in which corner? Tap the place in the north-west.
find.say: The school is in the north-west.
